MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

4. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 2
   C. 14
   D. 10

6. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

7. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

9. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 64
   C. 8
   D. 9

10. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

11. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 15.7

12. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

13. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

14. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 33
   C. 28
   D. 14

16. Solve for x: x + 5 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 5
   C. 9
   D. 4

17. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 170

18. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 36
   C. 37
   D. 5

19. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.025
   D. 2.5

20. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 45
   D. 30

22. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 10

23. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 121
   D. 11

24. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/2

25. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

26. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

27. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 1

28. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 11
   C. 3
   D. 28

29. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27

30. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
